title: Seat Reservation Manager
goal: Always reserve the smallest available seat and support returning seats.
strategy: Keep the set of currently free seat numbers. A reservation removes its minimum; an unreserve adds that exact held seat back.

phasePurposes.start: Always reserve the smallest available seat and support returning seats.

phasePurposes.done: Always reserve the smallest available seat and support returning seats.

edgeCases: Returning a larger seat does not skip smaller free seats
inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
